subject: Linguistics
title: Deixis: Context-Dependent Words
description: A quick win: understand Deixis: Context-Dependent Words.

hook.text: A note says 'I'll be back tomorrow.' Without knowing who wrote it and when, it's useless.

buildup.text: Words like 'I,' 'here,' 'now,' and 'this' shift meaning depending on who says them where.

discovery.text: These context-dependent words are called deictics—they point to the speech situation.

twist.text: Robots and AI struggle with deixis because they lack a shared physical context with humans.

climax.text: Every language has deictics—they anchor abstract words to the real world.

punchline.text: 'Here' means nothing until you know where.

quiz.question: What are deictic words?
options: Words whose meaning depends on context
